envelope.description: Add atomic review-state claims and recovery

body.title: Add atomic review-state claims and recovery
body.summary: Extend LocalStepStateStore/SharedStepStateStore and hub proxy/bindings with review/code-review-scoped claim/commit/release/invalidate operations, generation/call matching and bounded completion receipts. Do not change analyze/workflow lifecycle or add a database. Owner validation consumes a trusted internal context supplied by the lifecycle task.
acceptanceChecks: Atomic central claim permits one owner for a pending generation/call; cross-owner or stale commits/releases refuse. A non-consuming read never grants replay protection.
Missing declaration or invalid reply before side effects leaves state reusable; final claim remains exclusive through persistence and commits only on success.
Ambiguous persistence/cancel/owner loss invalidates rather than blindly regranting work; late owners are fenced; replay of a successful final call returns a bounded receipt without writing twice.
Live claims are pinned against ordinary TTL/capacity eviction, count against existing bounds, and explicit capacity errors replace silent eviction when all entries are pinned.
Local and real hub-worker tests exercise generation, duplicate requests, before/after-write failure, receipt bounds and unrelated-token independence.

tests.name: src/daemon/threads/__tests__/step-state.test.ts: atomic review claim commit generation recovery receipt and pinned-capacity invariants
src/daemon/threads/__tests__/review-state-concurrency.test.ts: two actual hub connections cannot consume or persist the same pending call twice
